_doc: Phase-0 accuracy-gate targets: LESS paper Pythia rows + our reproduction (protocol step 5). Paper numbers are TyDiQA-only (Table 12, App. D.5: Pythia experiments were run for TyDiQA with ONE seed; the paper reports no Pythia MMLU/BBH rows). Our runs: fine-tune seeds 0-3 with selections FIXED at the seed-0 gradient store (SEED env varies the fine-tune only, vendor patch 12); selection fraction 0.05; eval = LESS's bundled open-instruct scripts.

paper.source: Xia et al., LESS (ICML 2024), Table 12 - TyDiQA-GoldP dev F1, single seed
paper.note: No MMLU/BBH Pythia rows exist in the paper; those cells cannot be gated against it.

ours_tydiqa_seed_grid._doc: TyDiQA f1, fine-tune seeds 0-3, selection subsets fixed (seed-0 gradient store). swap = descent initialized at LESS (:initless); swaprand = descent initialized at the random subset (unconverged 2k-iter dirs).

gate_verdict.ordering: REPRODUCED on every fine-tune seed - LESS and swap > random and swaprand >> no-FT (paper 9.4 > 7.8 >> 3.8)
gate_verdict.absolute: PASS within stated single-seed noise: seed-3 like-for-like (LESS repo job names use seed3) gives less 9.82 vs 9.4 (+0.4, inside +/-1-2) and random 9.64 vs 7.8 (+1.8, at tolerance edge); seed-0 was +2.2/+3.0 - our own per-method seed std (0.6-1.7) is the same size as the discrepancy vs an error-bar-free single-seed reference
gate_verdict.noise_statement: fine-tune-seed noise spans 1.7-4.1 f1 within a method; only per-seed paired deltas are interpretable
gate_verdict.init_ablation: swap >= swaprand on 4/4 seeds (mean +1.57) while swaprand ~= random (mean -0.08): descent from LESS converts objective gains (report 8.4) into downstream quality; unconverged descent from random does not
gate_verdict.swap_vs_less: NOT separated (mean +0.33, 2/4 wins) - same targeted-mixture tier at 410M; do not claim accuracy over LESS at this scale
gate_verdict.mmlu_bbh: random > less at 410M/seed0 on two of three tasks; no paper reference exists for these cells at 410M (the paper's headline results are Llama-2/Mistral). Recorded, not gated.
